# Brand assets (copied, do not edit)

These files are copied from the organization's asset set in
[`dialectic-playground/.github` → `assets/docs/dist/`](https://github.com/dialectic-playground/.github/tree/main/assets/docs/dist).
Edit the source there, run its `tools/generate-assets.sh docs`, then copy the updated files
here again. They are not generated in this repository.
